coverage_notes: Pinned official template/sample style learning, not a claim that every initial submission must use every sample property.
Typeface, size and paragraph properties come from representative visible content runs; red/blue instruction font colors are not copied.
Word original source is not redistributed; converted part locators refer to the temporary derived DOCX, linked to the original download SHA256.
Character-count indents and automatic numbering remain source observations; no point-indent approximation is added.
The official template explicitly permits initial manuscripts to omit its detailed columns/fonts/sizes; this profile reproduces the sample format, not a mandatory initial-submission rule.
The physical source double-column section includes a preceding editorial annotation; the semantic manuscript split uses first_heading1 after excluding that instruction.

Physical source section starts before an editorial instruction. The semantic manuscript split starts at the actual 0 引言 heading; the excluded annotation and both source positions are recorded in extracted_format. Measured front_matter_page and body_page execute the distinct source section geometry.

extracted_format.mapping_basis: The source physical body section contains an editorial instruction before the real 0 引言 heading. The profile reproduces manuscript formatting after omitting template instructions; annotation text is never copied.
